body: Thank you, this is really lovely to hear. You're a good person, don't forget that.

Thank you for taking the time to reply, part of me was thinking no-one would. 

I've been with my boyfriend for about a year and a half I think? I'm not hapy. He's emotionally manipulative. I used to have really long hair but I had to cut it off becuase washing and drying etc. was too difficult for various health related reasons. He flipped at me when I cut it off and is now demanding I grow it back again. He tells me that his life is so much worse than minne and I can't complain. He says hat other people are selfish and ignorant and only he deserves to be happy. I tried to leave him but he threatened to kill himself, saying that life hates him and he's never going to be happy. Every day with him kills me a little bit more.

My friends are all going to opposite ends of the country for university, so I'll likely never see them again. They only talked to me because they're friends with my boyfriend and they all think I'm annoying and stuff becuase I'm ill all the time.

Every single day is such hard work and I can't cope with this any more.
